in_marathi.name: Mithun
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Friend, ally, relationship
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mithun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mithun is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mithuna', which means 'friend' or 'ally'. It is also associated with the zodiac sign Gemini, symbolizing the duality of friendship and companionship.
